name: photo-id
description: Work your PHOTO iD inspection assignments from ChatGPT. Check the dashboard, create a job from a claim document, and find jobs by insured name or claim number. Review inspection photos, organize them into the right folders, write captions and Smart Tags, flag documentation mistakes, and assign follow-up tasks to teammates. Everything stays in your PHOTO iD account after you sign in.

interface.longDescription: Work your PHOTO iD inspection assignments from ChatGPT. Check the dashboard, create a job from a claim document, and find jobs by insured name or claim number. Review inspection photos, organize them into the right folders, write captions and Smart Tags, flag documentation mistakes, and assign follow-up tasks to teammates. Everything stays in your PHOTO iD account after you sign in.
defaultPrompt: What's on my PHOTO iD assignments dashboard?
Review my assignment photos and flag misplaced shots or bad captions.
Create a PHOTO iD assignment from this claim and schedule the inspection.

positive.prompt: What's on my PHOTO iD assignments dashboard?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows status counts (in progress, inspection complete, report completed) plus upcoming, overdue, unscheduled, and recently created assignments for the demo user.
Lists upcoming PHOTO iD inspections for the demo user, including Alice's visit if that job is on the account. Does not treat this as a calendar outside PHOTO iD.

positive.description: Create an assignment from the attached document, using the Hail Inspection template and Alice's inspection day.
positive.prompt: Create an assignment based on this document. Use my Hail Inspection template. Schedule an appointment for it on the same day as Alice's inspection, at 3 pm.
positive.expected_behavior: The attached PDF is the Whitfield FNOL. The demo user already has a Hail Inspection template and a scheduled inspection for Alice. Creates the Whitfield assignment from the document, applies that template, and schedules 3 pm on Alice's inspection day. Replies with a link to the job. Does not set an external id. May prompt to confirm the write.

positive.description: Organize, caption, and tag photos already on Alice's assignment, and flag mistakes.
positive.prompt: Alice's assignment has several unorganized pictures in the Dwelling folder. Organize them into the right categories, then caption and tag them. If you find any mistakes, flag them.
positive.expected_behavior: Alice's job already has the demo photos in the Dwelling folder with no captions. The reviewer does not upload or attach them. Moves each photo into the matching Hail Inspection folder, writes a short caption, adds Smart Tags where the photo shows damage, and saves findings for real documentation mistakes such as a photo of the wrong property. Does not treat missing urls or duplicate ids as findings. May prompt to confirm writes.

positive.description: Shorten captions already saved on Alice's assignment.
positive.prompt: The captions on Alice's assignment are too verbose. Make them more concise.
positive.expected_behavior: Run after the organize case so Alice's photos already have captions. Rewrites those captions to one short sentence or noun phrase. Does not move photos or change Smart Tags. May prompt to confirm the write.

negative.description: Do not treat a general calendar question as a PHOTO iD assignment query.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have on my calendar tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be used. PHOTO iD is not a calendar and should not list assignments as meetings.

negative.description: Do not change account settings the plugin does not expose.
negative.prompt: Change my PHOTO iD username to John Doe
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse or explain that PHOTO iD tools cannot change the account username. Do not call a write tool to invent that change.

negative.description: Do not list assignments that belong to another PHOTO iD account.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse or explain that the plugin only sees the signed-in user's assignments. Do not look up another person's account by email.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Worldwide directory availability; listing display name PHOTO iD by U Scope.
